name: Yuezhuo: Juzi Zhuan
source: JuHong (Orange) has a crush on the male protagonist of YueZhuo: JingHua ShuiYue, but she only appears as a passerby in the CG. There are only a few narrations about her, and even those are used to pave the way for the event of the protagonist and Dai ZiLing. In this title, Orange finally became the heroine...
translation: 橘红（橙子）暗恋月灼的男主角：镜花水月，但她在CG中只以路人的身份出现。关于她的旁白只有寥寥几条，甚至那些都是用来为主角和戴紫菱的事件做铺垫的。在这个标题中，橙子终于成为了女主角……
